# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 26 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## NDR 2026: Housing Income Ceilings Revised Upward

- **BTO income ceiling raised to S$16,000; EC ceiling raised to S$18,000** - Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced at the National Day Rally that the HDB income ceiling for families is raised to S$16,000 (singles to S$8,000) effective 24 August 2026, and the EC ceiling climbs to S$18,000, widening access to subsidised housing. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/ndr-2026-bto-income-ceiling-raised-to-s16000-ec-ceiling-to-s18000/)

- **Stacked Homes breaks down what the new income ceilings mean for buyers** - A detailed explainer covers the revised BTO and EC thresholds, including the singles ceiling of S$8,000, with context on how the changes apply from 24 August 2026. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-raises-income-ceiling-to-16k-and-ec-ceiling-to-18k/)

## HDB Resale Market Sets New Price Records

- **Bishan 4-room flat becomes the first in the town to hit S$1.3 million** - A 4-room HDB resale flat in Bishan changed hands for S$1.3 million in August 2026, setting a new town record at approximately S$1,271 psf. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bishan-4-room-hdb-records-first-1-3m-natura-loft/)

- **Pasir Ris DBSS 5-room flat sells for S$1.15 million, S$167,000 above the previous record** - A five-room DBSS flat at 530D Pasir Ris Drive 1 sold for S$1,150,000 (S$1,018 psf) in August 2026, setting a new resale record for the flat type in Pasir Ris despite not being on the top floor. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/5-room-pasir-ris-dbss-flat-set-a-new-1-15m-record-167k-above-previous-high/)

- **18,425 HDB flats reaching MOP in 2026 across 22 projects** - A breakdown of which towns will see the most newly MOP-ed flats enter the resale market this year, with detail on 5-room and 2-room availability and pricing across locations. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/18425-hdb-flats-could-reach-mop-2026-where-buyers-will-have-most-choice/)

## Condo Rental Market Hits Record Highs

- **Condo rental prices and volumes both reached all-time highs in July 2026** - Singapore's condo rental market recorded simultaneous peaks in both rental prices and transaction volumes in July 2026, with the HDB rental market also reported to be strengthening. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-rental-prices-volumes-record-high-july-2026/)
